'''Ashteri's Cloud''' was a vast drift of ionized [[tuderium]] gas that floated along one edge of the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] as of [[44 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Ashteri's Cloud was visited by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Rockhound]]''. There, Calrissian and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] were [[Skirmish near Ashteri's Cloud|attacked]] by a group of [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] looking for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to capture for their [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|fleet]].<ref name="Vortex" />
